title: Translate installer placeholder and Linux build diagnostics
platforms: Desktop installer and Linux build tooling
changes: Translate Spanish comments, progress and error messages in the unconnected installer translator placeholder and the Italian Linux builder terminal prompt into English. Preserve the .lex representation and build behavior.
validation: Five Linux builder unit tests pass, including interactive failure and noninteractive exit behavior; bash -n passes and rustfmt parses the translator module. Checked that no installer module references the translator placeholder.
limitations: The translator remains an unconnected placeholder and was not compiled or executed as part of the installer; no Docker build or native GUI run was performed.
